name: seo-technical-audit
summary: Run a bounded site-level technical SEO evidence audit and return quality-gated findings.
inputs: site URL, sitemap URL, or local site artifact
external_reads: robots.txt, sitemap, linked assets, and selected page responses
approval_gates: external_read: obtain approval before crawling a live site or linked assets
vault_write: obtain approval before saving evidence unless vault_write is already authorized
production and external mutation: out of scope; this workflow never changes the target site
done_when: site, environment, target market, crawl cap, depth cap, and approval boundary are explicit
SiteOne or an equivalent bounded crawler ran or a blocked/setup-required state is recorded
raw stdout, stderr, metadata, and normalized packets are saved for each attempted tool
crawl scope, robots and sitemap completeness, metadata/indexability exceptions, response-header evidence, blocked requests, skipped checks, and affected URL samples are visible
findings distinguish observed crawl evidence from heuristics and hypotheses
seo-quality-gate passed or was explicitly deferred with a reason
verification: verify the primary crawler command includes explicit page and depth bounds
verify every executed command has captured exit status and limits
verify partial, blocked, sampled, and skipped evidence remains visible
verify no ranking, indexing, traffic, conversion, or AI-citation guarantee is claimed
verify recommendations are handed to developer, writer, WordPress, or production workflows rather than executed here
verify seo-quality-gate evaluates the interpreted findings
